description: This file defines an Orleans grain interface and a simple grain implementation that allows setting, incrementing, and multiplying two integer values.

classes.name: ISimpleGrain
classes.description: Interface for a simple grain with methods to set and get two integers.

classes.name: SimpleGrain
classes.description: Implementation of ISimpleGrain; stores two integers and provides methods to manipulate and retrieve their product.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of A by 1.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B; can be called with parameters for specific values.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.
